scope: Fresh portable C research execution at nominal35Hz,25C; measure elapsed-time learning while retaining earlier evidence; eventual Cortex-M23 target remains separate
recovery: Old workspace data/results were lost; this specification and all resulting datasets are a fresh campaign, not recovery of old numerical evidence

model.transport: Exact exponential transitions for actual piecewise-constant current; no state reset at event boundaries
model.hysteresis: SCM asymmetric charge-throughput law with separate positive/negative rates; freezes at actual zero current
model.known_OCV: Illustrative U25=3+1.15*z+0.08*tanh(8*(z-0.5)); user measured curve values unavailable
model.source: Exact actual current and clock, actual core temperature25C; point voltage at END of interval; truth excluded from estimator inputs
model.noise: Independent Gaussian1mV standard deviation per35Hz point observation; no claim about other rates under this model

common_bounds.trajectory_domain: Every candidate SOC must remain in supplied OCV domain

campaign.event_alignment: Durations are exact multiples of1/7s and therefore align with35Hz; source is constant inside each sample interval
campaign.meaning: Early prefixes lack opposite-sign excitation; retain gamma_minus as unknown. Later reversals can constrain it. A weak late window must not erase earlier evidence.
campaign.rate_comparison: Deferred; no universal assertion that35Hz is optimal or that20Hz/1kHz behavior has been reproduced
campaign.hardware_scope: Synthetic numerical laboratory history, not a hardware pulse recommendation

assessment.causality: Each prefix fit uses only observations through its checkpoint. Current-SOC error is evaluated at that checkpoint. Retrospective SOC trajectory reconstruction is labeled separately.
assessment.time_to_estimate: Report first sampled crossing and sustained-through-remaining-checkpoints crossing separately; no guarantee between checkpoints or beyond the observed history
assessment.uncertainty: Convergence of a numerical optimizer is not parameter identification. Preserve earlier measurement constraints and explicitly label unsupported or unresolved parameters.
assessment.profiles: Selected capacity and hysteresis-rate profile objectives across early/late prefixes; no default calibrated confidence coverage claim
assessment.performance: Host wall/CPU time, complete workspace/history storage, process peak RSS where available; no Cortex-M23 timing or bounded lifetime-memory claim
assessment.validation: Independent Python complete-dwell predictor plus selected independent constrained SciPy refinements; no reuse of C cached state or true OCV/SOC corrections
